description: This file defines the 'GenericGrainType' struct within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, representing a parameterized grain type with methods for parsing, constructing, and retrieving type arguments, as well as equality checks.

classes.name: GenericGrainType
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a generic grain type with methods for parsing, constructing, and comparison.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainType into a GenericGrainType, returning true if successful.

methods.name: GetUnconstructedGrainType
methods.description: Returns a non-constructed version of the current GenericGrainType.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Constructs a new GenericGrainType with specified type arguments.

methods.name: GetArguments
methods.description: Retrieves the type arguments of the GrainType using a provided TypeConverter.
